item.name: Get accounts with offers for consumer

request.name: Get accounts with offers for consumer

description.content: Looks up an existing account and returns relevant offers. If there is no existing account, this creates a new account and returns relevant offers.

query.description: Optional flag to indicate that only account lookup should be performed. If TRUE, then if there is no existing account, a new account will not be created.

response.name: Success
